menu_research_note: The Square Online storefront (alabaster-esthetics.square.site) is a fully client-side rendered Vue app (React/Vue SPA): curl/WebFetch only returns an empty #app shell, and the product/price API calls could not be replicated (undocumented endpoint, and headless-browser egress to squareup.com/instagram.com is blocked in this environment, confirmed via repeated Playwright net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET on multiple domains). Per PIPELINE.md's own guidance for Square-tenant businesses ('NO tienen dossier... Research manual: seguir el external_url de la bio de IG y sacar fotos+menu del IG real'), the real menu data used here was sourced from what the business itself has published on Instagram, Groupon and its own site config (categories, one verified price, and named treatments), rather than a complete priced menu. Services in the build without a confirmed price are shown as 'Book to see pricing' or 'By consultation' instead of an invented number, per the no-invented-data rule.

reviews.author: Victoria Clarke-Payton
reviews.text: I have been going to Jay at Alabaster Esthetic's since June 2024 and she is a true professional and I highly recommend her! She makes the spa experience relaxing, fun and enjoyable as it should be but she is also extremely knowledgeable about her art. She is amazing. Thank you Jay

reviews.author: D Pierce
reviews.text: Jaysalee explains her procedure very well while providing a calm, relaxing experience, even with micro-needling using numbing cream. I have noticed much improvement in the lines around my mouth and eyes plus lessened acne scarring. I am grateful I discovered Jaysalee and her professional etiquette.

reviews.author: Sonya Ray
reviews.source: Google (via Birdeye, full text sourced from an identical review the same customer posted on Groupon)
reviews.text: I am incredibly pleased with the extensive knowledge and professionalism Jay brings to her practice. Her expertise and specialized techniques, rare to find in the industry, set her apart, ensuring exceptional results. Jay's experience, ambition, and dedication all work together to provide a comprehensive range of services that truly meet her clients' needs. Beyond her skill, Jay is kind, humble, and compassionate.

reviews.author: Alyssa Nunez
reviews.source: Facebook (screenshot reposted on the business's own Instagram)
reviews.text: HUGE THANK YOU to Jaysalee! She did a Hydrafacial on my face (I suffer from horrible dry skin esp the nose area that did not go away). She was VERY knowledgeable, informed me on so many things that not even Dermatologists tell you about. I felt super comfy around her esp when asking questions, she was professional and very informative! A few days later and my skin is still hydrated, soft and the complexion looks soo good! It's always a great thing when you find someone who knows what they are doing and what they are talking about, 10/10 recommend! Thank you for helping my skin it sure needed it!

reviews.author: Jason
reviews.source: Google (screenshot reposted on the business's own Instagram)
reviews.text: Highly Recommend!! 6 visits dropped 20 lbs. Of course I had to put in some work with proper diet and exercise but definitely worth it. Jay is the best. Great customer service and cares about her clients.

reviews.author: Nan
reviews.source: Facebook (screenshot reposted on the business's own Instagram)
reviews.text: I went in for a facial with Jay and I loved it. She was very professional and would communicate and explain to me what she was going to do. I felt so relaxed and really enjoyed my facial with her. My skin felt great after and I would for sure go back to Alabaster Salon with Jay for another facial!

reviews.author: BR C.
reviews.source: Yelp (screenshot reposted on the business's own Instagram)
reviews.text: Jay is phenomenal and deserves way more than 5 stars!! She is the owner at Alabaster Esthetics LLC... Go check her out in the Gulf Coast Center!
reviews.note: Not used on the live site because it references the old Gulf Coast Center address (pre-move).

reviews.author: Dawn
reviews.text: Great service and feedback. Shay does her best to fit you in.

reviews.author: Debra
reviews.text: Best ever!!! Love, love, love this!

brand_vibe: Alabaster: pale cream/blush base with a warm dusty terracotta-rose accent (sampled directly from the business's own logo graphics and promotional posts: cream/blush backgrounds around rgb(234,225,220), a blush-tan rgb(214,185,169), and a dark espresso-brown script wordmark). Quiet, feminine, warm-neutral 'alabaster' luxury look, base clara (light-v2).
photos_source_note: All photos are real, downloaded from the business's own public Instagram feed (@alabaster.esthetics) via the pipeline's ig_photos.py -> Railway headless-browser service (12 real feed posts/videos retrieved). The account's recent posts are almost entirely promotional graphics (price cards, Valentine's Day sale, review screenshots) and a couple of unflattering treatment close-ups (extractions, TikTok before/after with visible irritation), which are explicitly prohibited from the gallery per the curation rules. After visual curation (every photo was viewed before selection): only 4 real, presentable images existed across the whole feed (a massage/facial photo, a body-scrub photo and a body-wrap photo pulled out of one composite promo graphic by cropping away the text/logo bands, plus a before/after skin macro from a 'Decongesting Facial' promo, also cropped clean of text). Per PIPELINE.md's own rule ('si quedan menos de 5 buenas, mejor menos secciones con buenas fotos que rellenar con malas'), the gallery was intentionally built with only 3 tiles instead of the usual 6, reusing the scrub/wrap photos from the About section rather than padding with extraction close-ups, review screenshots, or promotional graphics with text overlays. A small logo wordmark crop and a tiny icon-glyph crop (both from the business's own posted graphics) were used for the nav/footer logo and the small circular avatar/favicon.
